title: Uyo Asina Kubatwa Nemuedzo weMvura
intro: Munhoroondo dzemagwaro ekare, mune munhu anonakidza ane nyaya yake isingatangi nechishamiso chinoshamisa kana kuzarurwa kukuru, asi nemuedzo uri nyore asi wakadzama wekutenda. Rudzi rwakamira pamharadzano, ruchitsvaga hutungamiriri hwaMwari. Zvakaitika zvaive bvunzo yakangwara zvekuti yaizoratidza vatendi vechokwadi pakati pavo. Unogona here kutsanangura chakavanzika ichi kubva pane zvakasara?
clues: Ndaibva mudzinza raiyemurwa nevanhu, uye Allah vakandisarudza nechinangwa chitsvene chavaisagona kunzwisisa.
Muviri wangu waiva nechiratidzo chekusiyana icho vamwe vakanga vasina, zvichiita kuti ndive akasiyana nevanhu vangu.
Rwizi parwakaziviswa kuti ndirwo muedzo, vazhinji vakadzokera shure—asi ini ndakaenderera mberi, ndichitungamirirwa nekutenda kusingazununguki muchipikirwa chaAllah.
Ndakarayirwa kuti ndisambonwa mvura yakarambidzwa, asi donhwe rimwe chete rakabuda mumuromo mangu—chivi chakagara chichitambudza mwoyo wangu.
Mwari vakaronga kuti ndisangane nemufudzi wechidiki uyo rimwe zuva aizozivikanwa nekuuraya muvengi ane simba.
Mauto paakarwa, handina kuurayiwa neruoko rwemuvengi, asi ndakaurayiwa nemurairo waMwari sechirango chekusateerera kwangu parwizi.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
